{{Quote|I didn't know him well, but I know people used to tease him about that name. Like it was a bad omen.|translated=1|BB-8|<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />}}
'''V8-R''' was a [[Gender|masculine]] [[astromech droid]] who served in the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]] during the [[Resistance]]'s [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Some members of the Resistance were superstitious about V8-R's name, and he was teased for it.<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />

During the Resistance's [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on [[Starkiller Base]]<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> V8-R was in the [[astromech socket]] of the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] flown by [[Resistance pilot]] [[Furillo]]. Almost immediately into the battle, Furillo and V8-R were [[Death|killed]]. Later, following the [[Battle of Crait]], astromech [[droid]] [[BB-8]] recounted his memories of V8-R and the Battle of Starkiller Base to fellow astromech [[R2-D2]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />

==Behind the scenes==
V8-R was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]], which was written by [[Charles Soule]] and published in [[2018]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />
